## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (79%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Normal · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes Benign and Normal (20%) with 0% invasive risk (tier 1, unflagged) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 79%, Normal 20%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign over Normal |
| Conformal set | Benign, Normal (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot exclude Normal at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability, 44th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles (stain deg 3; AUROC 70%) [F6] | Typical embedding despite stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent encoders match each other |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign, 2/5 Normal (90%–92% similarity; Normal BACH_0090 91%) [F5] | Split between Benign and Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 6, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-1.08) strongly opposes invasive; 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.36) pushes toward invasive (19/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Typical level (-0.21) reduces invasive push; weak, 0/20 spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Lower overall confinement (+0.19) slightly raises invasive score (12/20 check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (deletion drop +0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132); all tile risks here equal 0.0.
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (drop +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (both 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Region 7 harbors true stromal invasion (+0.36, Validated) or inferior/lateral margins (80%, 51% vs 100% threshold) contain lesion [F7].
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) obscures Benign versus Normal distinctions (contrast case BACH_0090 differs in pleomorphism and invasion).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 7**: Inspect for infiltrating stroma (+0.36, Validated) versus benign mimickers; disregard the Unreliable mitosis score (0/20).
2. **Regions 6, 9, 10**: Verify two-layered lobules directly; the primary benign-supporting concept (-1.08) failed validation (0/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 2, 8**: Check ductal epithelium (region 2) and nuclear pleomorphism (region 8) to separate Benign from Normal.
